description:
Why the circle of people around you MATTERS 🙏 

World-leading high-performance coach @brendonburchard explains... we go even deeper in today’s episode of The School of Greatness 💫 

Comment YES & I’II DM it to you 💛

If you feel ready to reach your next level but aren’t exactly sure what you need to shift to get there, this episode is for you. Brendon reveals the playbook for creating a life of true abundance & fulfillment ✨

This conversation shifted so much within me & I can’t wait to hear what it opens up for you - just comment YES & I’II send it to you so you can watch or listen👇

#relationships #friends #boundaries #friendship #mindset
transcript: you're going to change one thing. And that is your environment, the people who you hang around. Yes. And soon as you do that at a high level, it shifts you into a gear that it's impossible to describe to people because most people really believe they're going to change their lives with their own personal will. And that is true until you plateau. Your personal will, it will change your life. It will get you outstanding results. It will make you great to a certain extent, but you will plateau at a certain level and you will know it. You'll be dissatisfied. You'll be bored. You'll be frustrated. You'll sense like, why do people have it more than me? And there's nothing wrong with you. This time of year, people think, well, your mindset is bad. Everyone thinks this time of year, your habits are bad. I'm like, oh, nothing's bad. You're just probably an A player playing on a B field. We got to get you an A player playing on an A field.
